rows.patch_description: Remove the exact transfer-identity uniqueness guard from the locked CBridge source.
rows.trigger: submit the same valid transfer twice
rows.control_expectation: the second transfer reverts with transfer exists
rows.mutant_expectation: the second transfer succeeds and the bridge receives the amount twice

rows.patch_description: Remove the exact timelock check from the locked CBridge refund path.
rows.trigger: refund a valid transfer before its timelock
rows.control_expectation: the early refund reverts with timelock not yet passed
rows.mutant_expectation: the early refund succeeds and marks the transfer refunded
